data.long_description:
2+Maid | High Floor | Burj Khalifa Views

Apartment for sale in Jumeirah Residences Emirates Tower A, Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers

Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exceptional 2-bedroom + maid's room premium corner apartment in Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers, Tower A by Meraas, managed by the renowned Jumeirah Group.
 
Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, this high-floor corner residence offers panoramic Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai and Zabeel Palace views through floor-to-ceiling windows, creating one of the most desirable layouts in the project.
 
 Property Details

 * 2 Bedrooms + Maid's Room
 * Premium Corner Unit
 * 1,590.37 Sqft
 * High Floor
 * Panoramic Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai & Zabeel Palace Views
 * Open Views from the Living Room & Both Bedrooms
 * Spacious Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
 * Large Internal Living Space with Excellent Layout Efficiency
 * Designer Semi-Closed Kitchen with Premium Built-in Appliances
 * Smart Home Automation System
 * Floor-to-Ceiling Windows Throughout
 * Two Private Balconies:
 
Large balcony accessed from both bedrooms, overlooking the Dubai skyline
Separate private entrance balcony, ideal as a service terrace or additional outdoor space
 
 * Maid's Room with Dedicated Bathroom
 * Guest Powder Room
 * Covered Parking

The thoughtfully designed floor plan separates the living and sleeping areas, creating excellent privacy while maximizing usable internal space. The expansive living and dining area flows seamlessly into the kitchen, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Both bedrooms benefit from direct access to the main balcony and enjoy uninterrupted skyline views, while the primary suite offers a generous walk-in area and luxurious en-suite bathroom.
